title: delphinium camporum var. penardii
intro: Delphinium camporum var. penardii, commonly known as Bear's Spur, is a perennial plant native to North America, specifically in the mountainous regions of western Canada and the United States. It belongs to the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae) and is valued for its medicinal properties. The plant is known to have anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can be attributed to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Bear's Spur include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its potential health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues.
